deviations.description: Plan's Task list says obtain the T10 baseline via `git show HEAD:...`. Used `git show 03e6f5660^:...` instead (the commit immediately preceding this task's own Phase 1 commit).
deviations.reason: By the time Phase 3 executed, this task's own Phase 1 and Phase 2 commits (03e6f5660 and the bundled 5eaade0ce) were already on HEAD, so `git show HEAD:...` would have returned the ALREADY-MODIFIED script -- comparing the new script against itself, which would trivially and meaninglessly pass. The plan's own Rollback/Contingency section and Risks table both establish 'pre-change' as the intended comparison baseline; 03e6f5660^ is the correct concrete resolution of that intent.
deviations.annotation: *(deviation: T10 baseline sourced from the commit preceding this task's own Phase 1 commit, not literal HEAD, because HEAD had already advanced past this task's own changes by Phase 3 execution time)*
